events.text: Committed 2bb40af22. The model-paint brush no longer uses BrushKit's generic hue-wheel (the exact 'conventional picker' the Color Studio handoff replaces). It now authors colour through the SAME ColorStudioWorkbench + shared colorSpine state the material surface uses — one current colour + one palette across the editor. Brush ink mirrors the studio current colour (oklchToHex). Editor bundles clean. Remaining for literally-everywhere: retire runtime BrushKit ColorField for hmsc-int pixel painter + demos (needs a runtime port of the studio).
